original_ai_output.title_zh: 英国法官对卢旺达种族灭绝案被告设定10万英镑保释条件
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 英国伦敦老贝利法院法官对涉嫌参与1994年卢旺达种族灭绝的嫌疑人Vincent Brown设定10万英镑保释金条件，并附加电子监控、宵禁和每日向警方报到等要求。Brown被指控在1994年4月6日至13日期间杀害、指挥或鼓励杀害图西族成员，他否认有不当行为。若未缴纳保释金，他将继续被羁押。该案为英国首例因卢旺达种族灭绝被起诉的案件，目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 英国法官对卢旺达种族灭绝案被告设定10万英镑保释条件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: UK judge imposes £100,000 bail condition on Rwanda genocide accused

key_facts.fact: Brown被指控杀害、指挥或鼓励杀害卢旺达图西族成员，他否认有不当行为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Brown is accused of "killing, directing or encouraging" the deaths of members of the Tutsi ethnic group in Rwanda. He denies wrongdoing.

key_facts.fact: 法官要求被告交出护照和身份证、不得申请国际旅行证件、遵守宵禁、接受电子监控并每日向警方报到
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Brown was also ordered to surrender his passport and any national identity cards, not to apply for international travel documents and was told he must abide by a curfew to live and sleep at his London address. He would also be electronically monitored and have to report daily to police.

key_facts.fact: 若未满足10万英镑保释条件，被告将继续被羁押
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Lucraft said that until the £100,000 condition was met, the defendant would remain in custody.

key_facts.fact: 1994年卢旺达种族灭绝持续100天，估计约80万图西族人和政治温和的胡图族人被杀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: An estimated 800,000 Tutsis and politically moderate Hutus were killed during the 1994 Rwanda genocide which lasted for 100 days.

uncertainties: Brown被指控的罪行尚未经法院判决确认
